# Eval X-Y(a,t)

![Eval X-Y(a,t) function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/formula-evaluation/18_Eval%20X-Y%28a%2Ct%29%20VI.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Uniformly samples paired X(t),Y(t) with fixed named parameters. This FROG profile reserves t as the independent parameter: a named parameter t is rejected, including when both formulas are constant. Parameters stay constant during the call. [a*cos(t),b*sin(t)] with a=2,b=1 describes an ellipse; the outputs remain two paired rank-one arrays. Fixed exact f64/Array signatures, without scalar lifting, broadcasting or implicit numeric conversion. Explicit FROG profile frog.studio.formula.evaluation@1 is distinct from the historical ODE dialect. Prepared payloads are validated versioned AST, never source to re-parse at evaluation or native pointers. NI connector documentation does not establish prepared binary compatibility or measured algorithm parity. error:i32 is local GS status (0=success); ticks:u32 measures elapsed calculation milliseconds, not point count.
